thread:
oom-bot: ALERT: gpu-prod-12 triggered 5 OOMs in 2m during a traffic burst. kernel-selector reported multiple kernel handoffs and queue growth. see runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oom

devon: digging in. quick profile: kernel_default workspace allocations +8x, fast-attn-v2 path workspace median 1.9GB vs baseline 1.0GB, kv-cache miss rate 42% (baseline ~6%).

sasha: this started right after the fast-attn-v2 rollout? we saw more large batches hitting the fp16 path which seems to pick a heavier kernel.

ana: fyi rollout at 2960000000. traffic burst shifted batch-size distribution to the right (p95 batch size doubled). kernel selector picked high-throughput kernel that uses larger workspace.

chris: immediate mitigation proposal:
- switch kernel-selector to conservative policy on impacted nodepool (favor small-workspace kernels)
- enable request-shaper to cap concurrent in-flight requests per GPU for affected routes
- reduce kv_ttl for low-signal routes to free KV slots quickly
- enable aggressive buffer-reuse flag as a short-term tradeoff (small perf hit)

devon: commands (rolling):
```bash
# conservative kernel policy on nodepool gpu-prod-12
infractl set kernel-selector --scope gpu-prod-12 --policy conservative
# enable request shaper for route /gen with max-concurrency 8
infractl set request-shaper --route /gen --max-concurrency 8 --scope gpu-prod-12
# per-route kv ttl script (reduce to 30s for low-signal routes)
python tools/kv_ttl_patch.py --routes-file affected_routes.txt --ttl 30
```

sasha: also flip on buffer reuse: `runtime.config.buffer_reuse=aggressive` — warns: expect ~2-3% p50 latency regression but big memory win. :warning:

ana: KV eviction knobs are tempting but increasing slots increases fragmentation risk. lowering kv_ttl for cold routes is lower risk and buys headroom.

chris: I'll apply kernel toggle + request-shaper now, devon take kv_ttl change. call out oncall when done. :eyes: 

devon: running infractl now...
`infractl set kernel-selector --scope gpu-prod-12 --policy conservative` -> applied. Observing immediate reduction in per-request workspace allocation on sampled hosts.

devon: kv_ttl script applied to affected routes. buffer_reuse flag pushed to canary subset.

oom-bot: RECOVERY: gpu-prod-12 OOM count -> 0 in last 60s. Monitoring for 15m. :white_check_mark:
